ModMetaData.author: mcocdaa

[h1]RimMind - Advisor (v2.0)[/h1] Autonomous colonist advisor, player approval workflow, and 3-round execution feedback engine. Analyzes colonist thoughts, personality traits, and macro colony crises to formulate character-consistent action proposals or execute low-risk tasks autonomously.
[b]v2.0 Clean Architecture & RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7 Dual-Version Support:[/b] [list] [*][b]RimWorld 1.6 & 1.7 (Waylith / .NET 10) Ready[/b]: Native multi-target compilation supporting both RimWorld 1.6 (.NET Framework 4.8) and RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10 / Harmony 2.x & 3.x). [*][b]v2.0 5-Domain Autonomy & Cabinet Proposals[/b]: Fine-grained per-domain autonomy policies, multi-colonist Cabinet Meeting crisis proposals, and smooth Mini-Pill HUD auto-collapse. Note: v1.x saves are not compatible with v2.0. [*][b]3-Round Execution Feedback Loop[/b]: Tracks tool execution outcomes and player approval/rejection history across up to 3 feedback cycles so the AI learns your command preferences. [/list]
[h2]What Is RimMind[/h2] RimMind is an enterprise-grade, AI-powered RimWorld mod suite. Integrated with Large Language Models (LLM), it transforms colonists into self-reflecting agents with distinct personalities, three-tier memories, natural spoken dialogues, autonomous mechanisms, and dynamic storytelling.

[h2]Core Features[/h2] [list] [*][b]5-Domain Autonomy Governance[/b] - Configure [i]Disabled[/i], [i]RequireApproval[/i], or [i]FullAutonomous[/i] across 5 operational domains: [i]EmergencySurvival, ResourceMarking, WorktableBills, BlueprintPlacement, HighRiskOperations[/i]. [*][b]Interactive Approval Cards & Mini-Pill Collapse[/b] - Proposals appear in a clean, zoomable floating HUD card with colonist reasoning, urgency badges, and [b][Approve][/b] / [b][Reject][/b] controls, collapsing into an unobtrusive mini-pill when idle. [*][b]ColonyMacroPerceiver & Cabinet Meetings[/b] - Detects colony-wide food shortages, medical emergencies, defense gaps, and mood crises, convening multi-colonist Cabinet Proposals with executable action plans. [*][b]Thought-Driven Decision Pipeline[/b] - Receives psychological Thought events from [code]RimMind-Personality[/code] and [code]RimMind-Dialogue[/code] via Core's loose-coupled event bus, turning inner monologues into concrete actions. [*][b]Pawn Lifecycle Safety[/b] - Automatically cancels pending proposals and cleans up state if a colonist is downed, kidnapped, or killed. [/list]
[h2]Advisor Decision Workflow[/h2] [list] [*][b]1. State & Thought Perception[/b] - Synthesizes pawn mood, skills, health, nearby work candidates, and macro colony alerts. [*][b]2. LLM ToolCall Reasoning[/b] - Selects character-appropriate mechanisms from [code]RimMind-Core[/code] and [code]RimMind-Actions[/code]. [*][b]3. Risk & Policy Resolution[/b] - [code]AdvisorToolRiskResolver[/code] checks domain autonomy rules to either execute immediately or queue for player approval. [*][b]4. Execution & 3-Round Feedback[/b] - Monitors completion and injects outcome feedback into subsequent advisor cycles. [/list]
[h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2] [b]Q: Will the AI perform dangerous actions without my permission?[/b] A: No. High-risk operations default to [i]RequireApproval[/i], presenting a floating proposal card so you stay in full command.
[b]Q: Does Advisor work better with Personality and Memory?[/b] A: Yes! [code]RimMind-Personality[/code] supplies Big-Five psychological traits and inner thoughts, while [code]RimMind-Memory[/code] provides long-term historical context for deeply consistent roleplay decisions.
